english.note: Use this for bringing something into existence, especially an abstract result or heat and energy; it is more about producing a result than causing an event.
Use this for producing an abstract result or for something coming into existence.
Use this when something arises as a result, especially when money lent produces interest.
Use this when something generates or brings about an effect, substance, or result rather than manufacturing an object.
